title: Living Room
tagline: Modern forms, comfortable layers and a confident yellow accent.
heroAlt: Contemporary grey living room with yellow accents
description: This living room balances a calm charcoal palette with warm yellow details. A simple furniture plan keeps the room open while layered textiles and focused lighting make it comfortable for everyday use.
challenge: Create a strong visual identity without making the room feel dark or crowded.
solution: We used a restrained material palette, a clear circulation path and concentrated color in a few memorable pieces.

gallery.alt: Grey living room with yellow decorative accents
Coordinated living area with grey seating
Media wall with clean black furniture

title: Everyday Living
tagline: A quiet composition built around space, light and one sculptural object.
heroAlt: Minimal grey interior with a yellow sculptural vase
description: Everyday Living explores how a small number of well-placed elements can give a room character. The open floor, soft natural light and single yellow object make the space feel calm but intentional.
challenge: Give a minimal room personality while preserving its sense of space.
solution: A low visual horizon, subtle shadow and one sculptural focal point create rhythm without clutter.

gallery.alt: Yellow sculptural vase in a minimal grey room
Relaxed corner with black and yellow details
Yellow chair beside a geometric wire basket

title: Material & Light
tagline: Soft forms and graphic details for a relaxed reading corner.
heroAlt: Relaxed reading corner with a black floor cushion
description: This compact corner uses texture and scale to make a simple setting feel inviting. The oversized floor cushion softens the graphic artwork, while the yellow clock and object carry the color story through the room.
challenge: Turn an unused corner into a comfortable and visually complete place to pause.
solution: We layered tactile fabric, graphic art and small functional objects at different heights.

gallery.alt: Floor cushion, artwork and yellow clock
Bedroom corner with a yellow chair
Minimal room with yellow sculptural object

title: Quiet Corners
tagline: A bedroom corner shaped for comfort, clarity and a little energy.
heroAlt: Bedroom corner with a yellow chair and grey textured wall
description: Quiet Corners brings function to the edge of a bedroom. The chair creates a useful place to sit, while the small bedside table, plant and textured wall give the composition balance.
challenge: Add useful seating without interrupting movement around the bed.
solution: A lightweight chair and compact table keep the layout flexible and visually open.

gallery.alt: Yellow chair beside a modern bed
Warm and layered bedroom interior
Informal reading corner with floor seating

title: Finishing Touches
tagline: Personal objects, soft seating and practical storage working together.
heroAlt: Grey living area with decorative shelving and yellow accents
description: Finishing Touches shows how accessories can complete a room without overwhelming it. Open shelving gives meaningful objects a home, while the rug, cushions and plants soften the harder architectural surfaces.
challenge: Display personal objects while keeping the living area calm and organized.
solution: We grouped decor by scale and color, leaving enough open space for every item to read clearly.

gallery.alt: Decorated grey living space
Yellow chair and geometric accessory
Coordinated bedroom and living details

title: Soft Contrast
tagline: A hardworking kitchen with bold color and warm natural texture.
heroAlt: Yellow and charcoal kitchen with timber work surfaces
description: Soft Contrast combines efficient storage with a bold yellow and charcoal palette. Timber surfaces warm the stronger colors, and the lighting plan keeps preparation areas clear throughout the day.
challenge: Fit generous storage and preparation space into one clean visual composition.
solution: Full-height cabinetry, a simple work triangle and integrated appliances keep the room efficient and ordered.

gallery.alt: Yellow kitchen cabinetry and timber surfaces
Modern neutral kitchen with open dining area
Black and yellow media wall

title: Amazing Bedrooms
tagline: A restful room built from warm light, quiet color and tactile layers.
description: Amazing Bedrooms focuses on the details that help a room feel calm. A clear furniture plan, layered bedside light and soft materials make the space comfortable from morning through night.
challenge: Create a bedroom that feels refined without losing warmth or everyday practicality.
solution: We combined accessible storage, soft lighting and a restrained palette with varied texture.

gallery.alt: Warm bedroom with layered lighting
Bedroom corner with compact seating
Grey interior with yellow accents

title: Modern Kitchens
tagline: Modern, minimal, ergonomic and made for everyday life.
heroAlt: Modern kitchen with a practical open layout
description: Modern Kitchens brings preparation, cooking and gathering into one connected space. Storage is placed where it is needed, durable surfaces are easy to maintain and the simple palette keeps the room visually calm.
challenge: Support cooking, storage and casual gathering without making the room feel busy.
solution: We organized the layout around daily movement and kept materials consistent across cabinetry and work surfaces.

Yellow and charcoal fitted kitchen
Open-plan living and dining area

title: Clean Lines
tagline: A graphic media room where storage becomes part of the architecture.
heroAlt: Black and yellow media room with clean-lined furniture
description: Clean Lines uses low furniture and wall-mounted storage to keep the room open. The yellow feature plane organizes the television and cabinetry as one composition, while black furniture creates a grounded foreground.
challenge: Integrate media equipment and storage without creating visual clutter.
solution: A single wall composition hides the functional elements and gives the room a strong architectural focus.
